sentence_of_record_E1: E1 (EMBEDDER-CROSS-FLAT E1-minimal; 2026-10-02, 0 calls; post-run review VALID). This is one label-free anchor-free nomic-embed-text build (N-raw, raw protocol, 84 leaves) on af_clean_s42's content-closed TRAIN (8,125 fit texts), compared with af_clean_s42 (qwen3, 82 leaves) on the 3,445 held-out questions of p2dca (content-closed under stem_key at norm-v1). FILING is HELD-WORSE: flatLeaf top-1 0.6813 against 0.7269, paired difference -0.0456, Wald 95% [-0.0617, -0.0294] (b 327, c 484; DEFF 1 measured, n_eff 3,445, realised MDE80 0.0230). F-E1 FIRES. The framing's planned SQ5 word "the method's" is overturned for the tree-FILING clause on MMLU-Pro (one corpus, one draw per arm). No recorded number moves, and this is not a scored embedder contrast. FLAT at the tree's own k: C1 and C2 FAILED; L1 FIRES on M1 (-0.0438 [-0.0572, -0.0299], spread_V 0.0136) and on M2 (-1.026 [-1.733, -0.321] x1e-3, spread_V 0.262; the margin over the tightened bar 1.009 is thin, 0.017). Reading: the purity loss appears in 2 of 3 qwen3 anchor-free re-draws (on M1 only; af_s42_o1 not independent; id-disjoint re-draws) and in the one nomic draw. The nomic draw also loses on M2, which no qwen3 re-draw did. P3 FIRES, P4 HELD, P7 FIRED. N-card (SECONDARY, D3 majority 8,242 of 8,324) reads alike and is not scored. DOES NOT SHOW: an embedder contrast as a scored test, embedder (in)variance in general, another corpus, or whether the loss is the embedder's or the draw's.

plain_description.what: The test built simple flat clusterings in two other embedding models (nomic, gemma) and with a keyword baseline, then compared them with the qwen3 embedder on MMLU-Pro. It measured how pure the clusters are and how much information they carry about the answer key, at 14 and at 82 clusters. The planned full tree build in another embedder was not run.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the partition results belong to the method or depend on one particular embedding model.
plain_description.information: Similar results across embedders would point to a property of the method. Large gaps would mean the results depend on the embedder. Result: done for the flat part only, descriptive. At 14 clusters, the other embedders are not shown to be worse than qwen3. At 82 clusters, nomic is worse. The keyword baseline is far worse. One corpus and one draw per embedder, with no claim of equivalence. The tree build in another embedder was not run.
